verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Angular's usage model centers on the Angular CLI, npm-based workspaces, and TypeScript compilation (angular-docs-9 through angular-docs-20), with no mention of a UMD/CDN build or script-tag inclusion. The only alternative to 'setting up a project' mentioned is an in-browser playground/tutorial (angular-docs-8), not a plain script-tag/no-bundler usage path.
